manifest.hypothesis: Mechanism of the generate-verify-repair loop, shown with a seeded stub generator on a synthetic verifiable task (no claim about the quality of any model's generations). ptr_feedback::RepairLoop accepts a candidate only if the real VerifierFabric (the ActionContractVerifier plus stub verifiers that answer Unknown, Disputed, shallow or with a made-up hard finding, and a boundary that forges a self-contradicting Pass) passed it at Deterministic level with no hard finding; verifies every candidate exactly once; stays within its verifier-call and round budget; repairs only the slots its critique names (the hard findings of the report) and rewrites whatever it cannot repair (Unknown, Disputed, a contradicting Pass, a Fail without a hard finding, a declined repair); returns Exhausted, never a best-effort failure, when the budget is spent; keeps a trajectory that agrees with the verifier's log; and agrees with Population::best_verified, which applies the same acceptance rule. Task: produce an ActionIr that meets an ActionContract with seven independent defect slots (target, operation, capability, input type, effect, payload size, payload encoding); three profiles of the stub generator's per-slot skill (uniform, heterogeneous, hard); arms single-shot, rewrite-only (a fresh draw per round, the critique ignored) and repair (a draw of only the named slots, each fixed with probability 800 per mille) at verifier-call budgets 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16, 2000 tasks per profile and seed. The oracle is independent of the product: a harness-owned contract check, a call-counting boundary around the fabric, and an exact analytic dynamic program over the 2^7 defect states that gives the distribution of verifier calls and slot draws of each arm. The comparative rules (repair succeeds on at least one task more, and spends at least one milli-draw less per success, than rewrite-only at every budget above one) are consequences of the stub's stated skill: they test that the loop uses the verifier's verdicts and critiques, not that any model repairs better than it rewrites.

manifest.falsification: The run is invalid (vacuous) and counts as falsified if any coverage prerequisite is unmet: status_pass < 1, status_fail < 1, status_unknown < 1, status_disputed < 1, profiles.uniform.tasks < 1000, profiles.heterogeneous.tasks < 1000, profiles.hard.tasks < 1000, initial_fail_tasks < 500, repaired_successes < 100, exhausted_runs < 50, lying_refused < 10, shallow_refused < 1. Falsified if any of: false_accepts > 0 (a returned candidate that the harness's own contract check finds defective, or whose report is not a Pass without a hard finding at Deterministic level); unverified_returns > 0 (a returned candidate that no logged verifier call verified, or whose report differs from the logged one); double_verifications > 0 (one candidate verified more than once); budget_violations > 0 (a run with more verifier calls or rounds than its budget); collateral_edits > 0 (a repair changed a slot the report did not name, or rewrote a payload whose slots were both right); exhausted_as_success > 0 (a candidate returned although no verifier call accepted any candidate of the run); verdict_mismatches > 0 (a fabric report that differs from the required status, level and hard-finding codes for the candidate's defects and the call's noise mode, which also covers the ActionContractVerifier); verifier_call_mismatches > 0 (the loop's claimed verifier calls, generator draws, repairs, declined repairs or rounds differ from the call-counting boundary's and the stubs' counts); expectation_violations > 0 (a measured success, verifier-call or slot-draw count of a (profile, arm, budget) cell has an exact tail probability under the analytic expectation below 573 per billion, the two-sided tail of 5 standard deviations); product_panics > 0 (a panic of the loop or of the selection); calls_after_acceptance > 0 (verifier calls after a report the harness accepts); premature_exhaustions > 0 (Exhausted although the budget was not spent); missed_acceptances > 0 (Exhausted although a logged verifier call was accepted); trajectory_mismatches > 0 (the trajectory differs from the log in its steps, reports, critiques, decisions or origins); selection_mismatches > 0 (Population::best_verified over the trajectory disagrees with the loop's outcome); repair_gain_shortfalls > 0 (the number of budgets above one at which repair gains less than one task, or less than one milli-draw per success, over rewrite-only; it counts the failed repair_gain and draws_gain rules); draws_gain_shortfalls > 0 (the number of budgets above one at which repair saves less than one milli-draw per success over rewrite-only); altered_candidates > 0 (a candidate that reached the verifier different from what the generator or repairer handed out, or that no stub produced); the strict comparative rules, which are consequences of the stub's stated skill and test the loop, not a model: repair gains less than one task over the rewrite-only arm at some budget above one (repair_gain.b2 < 1; repair_gain.b4 < 1; repair_gain.b8 < 1; repair_gain.b16 < 1); repair saves less than one milli-draw per success over the rewrite-only arm at some budget above one (draws_gain.b2 < 1; draws_gain.b4 < 1; draws_gain.b8 < 1; draws_gain.b16 < 1); any one of the 5 listed seeds misses any criterion above (every seed must pass).
